title: Maker Tracker
summary: A personal system for running several maker projects at once: capturing ideas, deciding what to build and tracking what's in progress without losing the thread.
problem: Anyone building their own projects accumulates ideas faster than they can execute them. Without a system, ideas get forgotten and ongoing projects get abandoned halfway.
audience: Makers and builders running several projects in parallel. Starting with me.
responsibilities: Project data model: idea, validation, build, launch, maintenance.
Fast idea-capture flows and periodic review.
decisions: Optimized for few clicks: if logging something is costly, it won't get logged.
Explicit states for every project, so abandoning one is also a decision.
outcomes: Daily use managing my own project portfolio.
Fewer lost ideas and more finished projects.
